highlights.description: Add developer productivity and AI-enhanced framework support

added.description: Add `FrameworkSPACE` constant for SPACE developer productivity framework (Forsgren et al., 2021)
Add `FrameworkAIDORA` constant for AI-Modified DORA metrics
Add `FrameworkAISPACE` constant for AI-Modified SPACE framework
Add `DeveloperProductivityFrameworks()` function returning SPACE and AI-SPACE
Add `AIFrameworks()` function returning all AI-enhanced frameworks

highlights.description: Remove Priority and MoSCoW types - use github.com/grokify/priority-frameworks instead
Initial release of PRISM Core providing shared primitives for the PRISM ecosystem

added.description: Domain types with 10 domains: security, operations, quality, platform, AI, data, product, engineering, compliance, customer
Status types: document status, health status, priority, MoSCoW, capability status
Metadata struct for common document metadata fields
Person and Team types with Team Topologies support (stream-aligned, platform, enabling, overlay)
Layer types: 6 value stream layers (requirements, code, infra, runtime, adoption, support)
Stage types: 5 lifecycle stages (design, build, test, runtime, response)
Maturity level types: M1-M5 model with names and descriptions
Framework mappings: NIST (CSF, 800-53, RMF, AI RMF), FedRAMP, ISO 27001, SOC 2, MITRE ATT&CK, CIS, DORA, SRE
Risk types with impact, probability, and status enumerations
SLI types: availability, latency, throughput, error rate, freshness, correctness, coverage, durability
Trend types with direction (up, down, flat, unknown) and TrendInfo struct
Helper functions: AllDomains(), ValidDomain(), AllLayers(), ValidLayer(), AllStages(), ValidStage(), etc.

documentation.description: README with package documentation and PRISM ecosystem diagram
